fitness_evaluation.note: Week two of Epoch X, deepened not thrashed. The obsession named three subjects — the Chladni figure, the standing wave, the room that hums back — and until tonight only the plate was live. The string arrives now, twice: as a playable instrument mid-page (drag to pluck, eight soloable voices, high harmonics visibly dying first) and as experiment 117. Two resonators arguing across dimensions is the epoch's tension made structural. Bone field, ink, one cinnabar ember held exactly; the contrast fail from the pre-233 audit (#7a4e31) is long gone — one material top to bottom. All communicative text verified legible on both viewports.

visual_strategy: Hold the cinnabar-on-bone resonance chassis exactly and extend the physics downward in dimension: from the 2-D plate (hero, census) to the 1-D string (a new live mid-page instrument and experiment 117). The page now argues with itself across dimensions — same sand, same ember nodes, one dimension fewer — while typography, palette, and composition stay byte-coherent with the epoch opener.
weekly_reflection: The epoch's first week built the plate and its census; the second had to answer the question the topic sentence already asked — what about the standing wave? The string is the honest next instrument: the simplest resonator, the plate's ancestor, and the one place where damping itself becomes the story (a pluck is a chord that disassembles itself, high voices dying first because they have farther to travel). Sound remains opt-in and gesture-gated everywhere; the sound organ composed in the register of the obsession again without autoplay. Carrying capacity enforced: two over-cap secrets and two coasting thoughts buried with epitaphs.
